LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingGasSourceModeDesc: The framework reuses gases and effects that already exist, from the game or from other mods, and carries its own only where nothing else does. This setting overrides that.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_GasSourceModeAutomaticDe: Other mods' and the game's gases where they exist; the framework's own gases where nothing else carries them. The default.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_GasSourceModeAlwaysOwnDe: Every framework gas runs, even where another mod's effect covers it. Mods that read gases then read the framework's.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_GasSourceModeExistingOnl: The framework carries no gas of its own. Mods that depend on one fall back to a simpler estimate, or do nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingSoundVolumeDesc: How loud the sounds of every D'thorga mod play: machines running, a switch clicking, a hull being found. At 100% each sits at the level of a comparable sound of the game's own, and the game's own volume sliders still apply on top. Turn it down to quieten them, to 0% to silence them, or up to {MAX}% to hear them more plainly. It changes at once; a sound already playing follows when its next loop begins.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingSystemSoundsOnOth: Vehicle system sounds on other mods' vehicles too

The sounds of D'thorga Framework's vehicle systems (a tyre bursting, an engine knocking, coolant boiling, a key turned on a flat battery, the soft chime when a red warning lamp lights) belong to the systems, so they play on any vehicle running them, including other mods' vehicles given our systems. Their engines, doors and weapons always keep their own authors' sounds. Off: only D'thorga's own vehicles play these.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingShowGasOverlay: Show gases at the mouse (dev mode)
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingKeepGameLogAlive: Keep the game's log going after its message limit
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingKeepGameLogAliveD: RimWorld stops all logging, its Player.log file included, once a session has written 10,000 messages, and only loading a save turns it back on; one mod's repeating error can reach that in minutes, and then nothing that goes wrong afterwards is written down. With this on, the log is turned back on when that happens, at most {COUNT} times a session, and one line names the message that filled it. It changes nothing until the game has stopped its log. Off: the game's own limit stands.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingWriteColonyMoodFi: Write a colony mood file at each save

For D'thorga Companion and phobos-modkit's mood report. A save holds only the moods colonists remember; the rest (bedrooms, pain, cold, beliefs) is worked out while the game runs. With this on, each save also writes every colonist's, slave's and prisoner's thoughts, as the game adds them up, to {PATH}, so the report can name every cause. Takes a moment at each save and nothing in between; the file is replaced each time and stays on this computer. Off: the report works from the save alone.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingWritePatchedDefs: Write every Def with all patches applied at the next start (dev mode)
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingWritePatchedDefsD: For mod developers. At the next start, once the game has loaded, every Def is written as it stands after every mod's XML patches (before inheritance) to {PATH}, for phobos-modkit's Def tool. Takes a few seconds and a few hundred megabytes on disk with a large mod list; turns itself off once written. The file holds other authors' Defs: keep it on this computer.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingShowGasOverlayDes: In development mode, a small label follows the mouse naming every gas the framework can see in that cell's room.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_DisplayModePlainDesc: Words only. No percentages, no figures.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_DisplayModeOperatorDesc: The figures a practitioner would want to see.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_DisplayModeEngineerDesc: The full working, line by line.
LanguageData.PhobosProtection_PointCloses: Closes off the {ROOM} as a {ZONE}. Colonists need {STAT} of {REQUIRED} or more to go in, and stop at the door to put on gear first.
LanguageData.PhobosProtection_PointFacesWall: Faces a wall, so it closes off nothing. Turn it to face into a room, or into a doorway.
LanguageData.PhobosProtection_PointFacesOpenGround: Faces open ground, which a sign can't close off. Paint a controlled area there instead.
LanguageData.PhobosProtection_TurnedBack: {PAWN_labelShort} won't go into the {ZONE}: there is no gear in reach that gives enough {STAT}. {PAWN_labelShort} will keep clear of it for an hour.
LanguageData.PhobosProtection_AreaExpandDesc: Paint where protective gear is needed. Colonists stop at its edge to put gear on, and take it off again just outside when they leave.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_ResearchGranted: Your engineers and doctors wrote up what the colony already knows: {COUNT} research projects are complete.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_ScreenFault: This could not be shown just now. The details are in the log, and it will try again in a few seconds.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingBillPartsDesc: Some things of ours are built from parts: an engine, a fuel tank, tyres. Other mods make such parts too. This chooses whose parts a build asks for. A change takes effect the next time the game starts.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_BillPartsOthersDesc: Where a mod you have installed makes a part that suits, a build asks for that part. Everything else is ours. Repairs accept either, as before.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_BillPartsOursDesc: A build asks only for our own parts and materials, whatever else is installed.
